briefings.title: Nick Shirley: Exposing Government Fraud, Suing California & Taking on the Media
briefings.tldr: Independent investigator Nick Shirley shared his efforts exposing government waste and fraud—such as California's multi-billion dollar high-speed rail project and multi-million dollar daycare schemes—prompting California to pass AB 2624 (the "Stop Nick Shirley Act") to curtail his reporting.

briefings.title: AI Kills Everybody or Doomer Psyop? OpenAI’s Math Breakthrough, Nike’s $200B Collapse

briefings.title: Nvidia's Historic Quarter, SaaS Comeback, Bessent vs Druck, America's Debt Crisis, Cancer Vaccine
briefings.tldr: Nvidia and Salesforce delivered blockbuster earnings reports, shattering the "AI capex bubble" and "SaaSpocalypse" narratives, while debates flared over US fiscal policy, Stan Druckenmiller's AI-assisted op-ed, and Moderna's mRNA cancer vaccine.

briefings.title: Inside Trump's Science Agenda: Anti-Science Claims, Fauci's Damage, DEI & China w/ Michael Kratsios
briefings.tldr: The White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) is overhauling federal science funding through its new "Science: A New Golden Age" initiative to eliminate administrative bloat, defund political mandates, and aggressively back high-impact breakthroughs.

briefings.title: The Fight Over Open Source AI, Anthropic's $1.5B Payout, NYC Socialists: Evictions = Violence?

briefings.title: Can the AI Industry Regulate Itself? Stripe Wants PayPal, China Catches Up, NY Bans Datacenters
briefings.tldr: The AI industry is pivoting toward a self-regulatory model (SRO) to avoid stifling government oversight, while a massive $53B bid for PayPal by Stripe and Block signals a major consolidation in the payments sector aimed at challenging the Visa/Mastercard duopoly.
